photo_truth.truth_rule: A verified article is not VISUAL_READY. Every story requires a story-specific real, semantically relevant, rights-cleared and approved visual plus external readback where enabled; generic or synthetic-as-photo substitutes remain forbidden. IPJ/ISU/ISJ approvals additionally require exact article-source and candidate-fingerprint binding so identity drift cannot inherit visual approval.
